definitions.gloss: relative; relation; kin; someone to depend on
definitions.explanation: A person one can rely on, especially a family member or close relative. Most commonly used in negative expressions to describe someone who has no relatives or no one to turn to.

examples.japanese: {身寄|みよ}りのない{老人|ろうじん}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of elderly people with no relatives is increasing.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}には{身寄|みよ}りが{一人|ひとり}もいない。
examples.english: I have not a single relative in this town.

examples.japanese: {身寄|みよ}りのない{子|こ}どもたちのために{施設|しせつ}が{設|もう}けられた。
examples.english: A facility was established for children with no family to rely on.

notes:
USAGE:
{身寄|みよ}り is most commonly used in the pattern {身寄|みよ}りのない (without relatives, without anyone to depend on). It is rarely used in positive contexts like "having many relatives."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身寄|みよ}りのない{人|ひと} (a person without relatives)
- {身寄|みよ}りがない (to have no relatives)
- {身寄|みよ}りを{頼|たよ}る (to rely on a relative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{親戚|しんせき} is the general word for relatives and is used in neutral or positive contexts. {身寄|みよ}り specifically implies someone one can depend on and is typically used when describing the absence of such support.
